newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chips pause after big rally, Nasdaq racks up gain.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chips pause after big rally, Nasdaq racks up gain.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed lower Wednesday, one day after the Dow posted its second largest daily gain ever, while the Nasdaq market shook off its recent bearish trend to end higher.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed 20.87 points lower at 6,812.72. The Nasdaq Composite index rose 14.41 points at 1,227.15.
In the broader market, declining issues led advances by a modest margin on active volume of 493 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
